title: $model - getPrimaryKey()/getLastInsertId() returns wrong value when tables has triggers

labels.name: status:to be verified
labels.description: Needs to be reproduced and validated.

body:
<!--
Please use this issue tracker for bugs and feature requests only. In case you need support please use one of
Yii communities listed at https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/wiki/communities
-->

### What steps will reproduce the problem?

```php
$model = new Model();
$model->name = 'model name';
$model->save();

/*
this should return the id of newly inserted row to Model table,
But when table has a trigger that inserts into another table,
returns the id of row inserted to that audit/historic table instead
*/
echo $model->getPrimaryKey();
echo $model->Id;
echo $model->getDb()->getLastInsertId();
```

### What is the expected result?

We expect is a newly assigned ID according to AutoIncrement PK 

### What do you get instead?

Returns the id of the row inserted to the audit/historic table.

### Additional info
We tried directly on sql server like this:

```sql
INSERT INTO table ([Name]) VALUES ('Test');
SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() as ScopeID, @@IDENTITY as IdentID;
```

The newly row created, ScopeID returns the correct ID and IdentID the ID of row inserted into Log table.

We checked the method lastInsertId  from PDO ( class yii2\db\mssql\PDO ), and SCOPE_IDENTITY() returns null, so maybe the connection is not the same?! so returns value from @@IDENTITY instead.

```php
   /**
     * Returns value of the last inserted ID.
     * @param string|null $sequence the sequence name. Defaults to null.
     * @return int last inserted ID value.
     */
    public function lastInsertId($sequence = null)
    {
        return $this->query('SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SCOPE_IDENTITY(), @@IDENTITY) AS bigint)')->fetchColumn();
    }
 ```

| Q                | A
| ---------------- | ---
| Yii version      | 2.0.15.1
| PHP version      | 7.1
| Operating system | Windows 10/Server 2012
| Sql Server | Microsoft SQL Server 2017 (RTM) - 14.0.1000.169 

config/db.php

```php
$db = [
	'class' => 'yii\db\Connection',
	'dsn' => 'sqlsrv:Server=localhost\SQLEXPRESS;Database=DTEMP',
	
	'username' => 'usr',
	'password' => 'pwd',
	'charset' => 'utf8',
	
	'enableSchemaCache' => true,
	'schemaCacheDuration' => 12 * (60 * 60), // 12 * 1 hour
	'schemaCache' => 'schemaCache',
];
```
config/web.php

```php
$db = require __DIR__ . '/db.php';
...
$config = [
...
	'components' => [
		'db' => $db,
	...
```
